summary: Frontend-only validation of RainbowKit + wagmi + viem wallet integration. Confirmed the fixed top-right Connect Wallet button on the main menu (bbox x=1761, y=16 at 1920 viewport => top-right), that clicking it opens the RainbowKit modal ([data-rk] + role=dialog rendered) with wallet options Rainbow, Base, MetaMask, WalletConnect under 'Connect a Wallet', and that the same button remains fixed top-right over the game canvas after clicking OYNA (data-testid='play-btn'). No wagmi/rainbowkit/viem runtime errors surfaced; only the expected Next.js dev webpack-hmr websocket 400 messages appeared, which are benign and explicitly excluded per the request.
critical_code_review_comments: wagmi.js: projectId reads NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID; if unset in prod build, WalletConnect connector will silently drop. Consider a runtime assert or warning log when env is missing.
chain.js: only default RPC url is declared. When Robinhood RPC is degraded, viem has no fallback transport; consider adding a fallback (http()) list for resilience.

_app.js: WalletButton is rendered globally including on transient screens like BootScreen / EndScreen — visually verified this is intentional per spec, but z-[60] may overlap PauseOverlay/EndScreen close buttons on smaller viewports; verify on mobile widths.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4: top-right button, modal opens with wallet options, button persists in-game, no wagmi/rainbowkit/viem console errors)

test_credentials: none required (no wallet extension available in automation env; real wallet connection intentionally not attempted per request)
context_for_next_testing_agent: RainbowKit modal is verifiable via locator('[data-rk]') and role=dialog. Wallet options text: Rainbow, Base, MetaMask, WalletConnect. Wallet button data-testid='wallet-connect-container' renders <ConnectButton/>; when disconnected the accessible name is 'Connect Wallet'. In-game state entered via [data-testid='play-btn'] on MainMenu. HMR websocket 400 errors are expected dev noise.
